mapper.sql: PLAN_ID, PLAN_NO, PLAN_NAME, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_YEAR, PLAN_QUARTER, PLAN_MONTH, FINANCING_TARGET, ACTUAL_AMOUNT, COMPLETION_RATE, PLAN_STATUS, APPROVAL_BY, APPROVAL_TIME, APPROVAL_OPINION, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, CURRENCY, DEPARTMENT, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, DELETE_FLAG

sql.where:
DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND PLAN_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{planNo}, '%')
AND PLAN_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{planName}, '%')
AND PLAN_TYPE = #{planType}
AND PLAN_STATUS = #{planStatus}
AND PLAN_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND PLAN_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_FINANCING_PLAN
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC
SELECT FROM TBL_FINANCING_PLAN WHERE PLAN_ID = #{planId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO TBL_FINANCING_PLAN ( PLAN_NO, PLAN_NAME, PLAN_TYPE, PLAN_YEAR, PLAN_QUARTER, PLAN_MONTH, FINANCING_TARGET, ACTUAL_AMOUNT, COMPLETION_RATE, PLAN_STATUS, APPROVAL_BY, APPROVAL_TIME, APPROVAL_OPINION, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, CURRENCY, DEPARTMENT, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, DELETE_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{planNo}, #{planName}, #{planType}, #{planYear}, #{planQuarter}, #{planMonth}, #{financingTarget}, #{actualAmount}, #{completionRate}, #{planStatus}, #{approvalBy}, #{approvalTime}, #{approvalOpinion}, #{planStartDate}, #{planEndDate}, #{currency}, #{department}, #{operator}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as FINANCING_TARGET, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as ACTUAL_AMOUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN PLAN_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as COMPLETION_RATE, SUM(FINANCING_TARGET) as PLAN_YEAR FROM TBL_FINANCING_PLAN WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
